errors.text_span: Die höchsten Werte beider Gruppen finden sich im Einkommensbereich 20–<40
errors.evidence: This statement is incorrect. While the highest value for the "Entlastete" group (1,240) is in the 20-<40 bracket, the highest value for the "Belastete" group (660) is in the 40-<60 bracket.

errors.text_span: Einige Balken sind mit numerischen Werten beschriftet
errors.evidence: The description states that "some bars" have numerical labels, but the chart clearly shows that all 14 bars are labeled with their exact values.
